RABAT FLOW / WORLD CUP 2030Built with Codex ↗

A demonstration, with the assumptions visible. Vehicles, traffic, passenger demand, journey times and improvements are simulated. Rabat landmarks are approximate; connections are illustrative. No live transport feeds, dispatch system or AI inference are connected. The OpenAI Sans typeface and Build Day inspired palette are used for this independent community project.
